recent_events.title: Government announces new $1 billion BDC tariff support program for metals industry
recent_events.description: The Government of Canada announced a new $1 billion BDC program to provide preferentially priced loans to Canadian steel, aluminum and copper producers impacted by U.S. Section 232 tariffs. Loans range from $2M to $50M with repayment terms up to 36 months.
recent_events.impact: Major expansion of BDC's mandate to support strategic industries amid Canada-U.S. trade tensions; demonstrates BDC's role as a counter-cyclical policy instrument

recent_events.title: BDC launches $500M LIFT program for SME AI adoption
recent_events.description: BDC launched the LIFT (Lead with Innovation and Focus on Technology) initiative, a $500 million program aiming to help over 1,000 SMEs adopt AI. Only 30% of Canadian SMEs used AI in 2025, but those that did were 24% more productive. The program prioritizes Canadian-developed AI tools.
recent_events.impact: Significant push to close Canada's SME AI adoption gap; aims to boost GDP by up to 14% if SMEs reach higher digital maturity

recent_events.title: BDC publishes 2025 Annual Report with record $11.5B in new financing
recent_events.description: BDC served a record 107,345 entrepreneurs (47.4% increase since FY2021), provided $11.5 billion in new loans and investments, and achieved net income of $402M. BDC injected nearly $1B into venture capital through its Growth Venture Fund and Growth Equity Partners program.
recent_events.impact: Demonstrates BDC's expanding role in reversing Canada's entrepreneurship decline; financing projected to add $25B to GDP over 5 years

recent_events.title: BDC publishes 2025 Venture Capital Landscape report warning of ecosystem challenges
recent_events.description: BDC Capital's annual VC report highlighted weakening investment returns and companies running out of cash as deal making dwindles. The report issued a 'collective wakeup call' for Canadian investors to invest domestically and reduce reliance on international markets.
recent_events.impact: Influential report shaping national debate on VC ecosystem sustainability; BDC advocating for greater domestic capital mobilization

recent_events.title: BDC launches $500M Pivot to Grow loan for tariff-impacted SMEs
recent_events.description: BDC launched a $500-million envelope called Pivot to Grow, providing financing, advice and loan deferrals to SMEs likely to be financially impacted by U.S. tariffs or the uncertainty they may create.
recent_events.impact: Rapid response to U.S. trade policy shifts; positioned BDC as a key instrument in Canada's economic resilience toolkit

core_business: 加拿大商業發展銀行（BDC）是加拿大聯邦政府全資擁有的皇家公司，也是加拿大唯一的國家開發銀行，成立於1944年，總部位於蒙特利爾。BDC的核心使命是通過融資、諮詢服務和資本投資幫助加拿大中小企業（SME）的創建與發展。主要業務包括：商業貸款（從2.5萬加元至500萬加元以上）、通過BDC Capital提供風險投資和成長股權投資（管理的增長風投基金規模近10億加元）、以及面向企業家的諮詢服務（涵蓋AI應用、生產力提升和戰略規劃）。BDC在全國擁有超過123個商業中心，服務超過10.7萬家客戶企業，其客戶共僱傭約140萬加拿大人，年收入總額達5720億加元。2025財年BDC提供115億加元的新增貸款和投資，預計未來五年將為加拿大GDP貢獻250億加元。BDC是加拿大最活躍的風險投資者（按交易數量計算），其投資組合涵蓋能源/清潔技術、醫療健康和信息技術等多個領域。近年來BDC積極推出針對AI應用的5億加元LIFT計劃、針對關稅影響企業的10億加元金屬行業支持計劃，以及服務原住民和黑人企業家的專項平台。BDC自1998年以來持續盈利，是加拿大百佳雇主之一，也是加拿大首家獲得B Corp認證的金融機構。
apec_stance: BDC作為加拿大國家開發銀行，本身並非APEC論壇的直接參與者，但通過支持加拿大中小企業的國際化發展間接服務於加拿大的APEC戰略目標。BDC的風險投資部門BDC Capital是加拿大最活躍的早期風險投資者，其投資的許多科技初創企業活躍於亞太市場。在加拿大推進'印太戰略'的背景下，BDC通過幫助中小企業提升生產力和競爭力，間接增強了加拿大企業在APEC區域的貿易和投資能力。2025年發布的風險投資報告強調了減少對國際資本市場依賴、加強國內投資的重要性，這與APEC促進區域經濟韌性的目標一致。BDC的LIFT計劃（AI應用）和出口多元化支持也與APEC推動數字經濟和貿易便利化的議程相呼應。
